name: afk-pipeline
description: Automated multi-agent orchestration pipeline for PRD slices

scripts.test: pnpm run test:fast && pnpm run test:heavy:orchestrator && pnpm run test:heavy:wave && pnpm run test:heavy:resume && pnpm run test:heavy:qa && pnpm run test:heavy:clean && pnpm run test:budgets
scripts.test:heavy: vitest run src/orchestrator.test.ts src/wave.test.ts src/resume-integration.test.ts src/qa-orchestration.test.ts src/clean-failed.test.ts
scripts.test:heavy:orchestrator: node scripts/timed-suite.mjs orchestrator vitest run src/orchestrator.test.ts
scripts.test:heavy:wave: node scripts/timed-suite.mjs wave vitest run src/wave.test.ts
scripts.test:heavy:resume: node scripts/timed-suite.mjs resume-integration vitest run src/resume-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:heavy:qa: node scripts/timed-suite.mjs qa-orchestration vitest run src/qa-orchestration.test.ts
scripts.test:heavy:clean: node scripts/timed-suite.mjs clean-failed vitest run src/clean-failed.test.ts
